[EN] A screaming has stopped recently.

Killian has taken another life... The one we should have saved!!

We will bring death to Killian and his followers!
[ES] Un grito se ha detenido hace poco.

¡Killian se ha llevado otra vida... La que debimos haber salvado!

¡Llevaremos la muerte a Killian y a sus seguidores!
